South Delhi building collapse report cites MCD lapses and fabricated records

A report on the South Delhi building collapse has identified lapses by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) as the primary cause. The inquiry found that inspection records were fabricated to mislead investigators. The report specifically flagged these actions by the MCD in relation to the Saket building collapse.
